methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: The technical content of all identified papers is thoroughly reviewed and their key features and objectives are highlighted.

paper_type.evidence_quote: This paper presents a literature review on methodologies reported in the scientific literature exploring the potential value of industrial data via the utilization of Machine Learning tools for energy efficiency related goals.

level_3b.evidence_quote: The majority of contributions address challenges in petrochemical industries, and namely in ethylene production.

stage1.notes: Review spans mixed industrial sectors; Level 3B is true because most characterised applications are petrochemical/ethylene.

multi_site.evidence_quote: A total of 42 published papers are found to present original contributions in this field, and addressing multiple energy efficiency challenges.

sector_of_activity.evidence_quote: This paper explores the utilization of ML tools in the manufacturing and process industries for EE goals

type_of_organisation.evidence_quote: A collection of works in nine other industry types was also identified, though including a limited number of contributions.

ems_standard.evidence_quote: The introduction of the ISO 50001 standard in 2011

evidence_quote: This paper presents a literature review on methodologies reported in the scientific literature exploring the potential value of industrial data via the utilization of Machine Learning tools for energy efficiency related goals.

Model: Adaptive Network-based Fuzzy Inference System (ANFIS) and first-principles model for computation of expected power consumption for two distinct technologies given a set of operating requirements.
Model: Charnes–Cooper–Rhodes (CCR) DEA model to build EE model.

Model: Five parallel ELM neural networks, each using a different nonlinear function to transform process inputs. A weight from each network is determined using least squares, to map energy consumption to selected process inputs.
Model II: Calculation of global EE indicator, by assignment of weights to individual indicators using AHP or Correlation Coefficient (CC).

normalisation_variables.evidence_quote: One of the key focus is assessment of the impact of production load on EE and obtaining meaningful baselines for EE calculation.

baseline_construction_method.value: Dynamic worst- and optimal-performance baselines for energy-efficiency indicators are calculated by sequential quadratic programming subject to an ANN model.
baseline_construction_method.evidence_quote: Baselines: Calculation of dynamic baselines (worst and optimal performance) for EE indicators using Sequential Quadratic Programming (SQP) and subject to developed ANN model.

validation_types.evidence_quote: Validation: Data split in training and test sets. R2 for accuracy checks.

scale_of_application.evidence_quote: Method applied to ethylene plant, taking crude oil, fuel, steam, water and electricity and output is ethylene production.

scope_description.evidence_quote: This paper explores the utilization of ML tools in the manufacturing and process industries for EE goals

identifies_model_limitations.evidence_quote: Some processes may experience dynamic/delay effects, where others may include a huge number of measurements, and possibly subject to systematic bias, or data acquisition errors. Consistent data is key for model development and model accuracy.

specific_limitations.evidence_quote: Noise affects reliability of results and the confidence of decisions taken. Relates to data measurement and pre-processing.

proposes_treatment_mechanism.evidence_quote: ML tools: Fuzzy logic, OLS, PCA, SVC. Other tools: MAF, QR decomposition.

proposes_adaptations.evidence_quote: This tool is an adaptation from the standard FLNN architecture. It uses PCA as a middle step to reduce the potential large number of inputs to the neural network.

adaptation_types.evidence_quote: This tool is an adaptation from the standard FLNN architecture. It uses PCA as a middle step to reduce the potential large number of inputs to the neural network.

empirical_refinery_application.evidence_quote: Method applied to ethylene plant, taking crude oil, fuel, steam, water and electricity and output is ethylene production.

data_type.evidence_quote: Daily data are fused into monthly and yearly data using Hierarchical Variable Variance Fusion (HVVF), yielding energy consumptions for the same technology.
